deliberateNativeDifferences: The Web prototype does not imitate UIActivityViewController, AirDrop targets, or third-party destinations.
The Viewer toolbar uses the exact recorded share-network and trash template vectors; other HTML icons remain optical analogues whose recorded SF Symbol identities apply only to their native rows.
The generic review frame is a viewport aid and not physical-device evidence.
The iCloud progress and local-integrity fixtures simulate visible states only; they do not download, hash, parse proof data, or establish a credential verdict.
Haptics, PhotoKit, AVPlayer, signing, ZIP generation, cancellation at the resource layer, and temporary-file cleanup require native tests.

behaviorAuthority.scope: Viewer original readiness gates Share; ready originals receive local integrity checking without backend Verify; Failed disables TAPNAP while ordinary media remains available with an explicit unverifiability warning; Needs Retry is queue-only.
